ABOUT

At Reform by Energym, we believe that the perfect balance of Pilates and fitness creates stronger, healthier bodies and happier minds. Our studio is a welcoming space where everybody can move with confidence, challenge themselves, and enjoy the benefits of intelligent movement.

Our mission is to combine the precision of Reformer Pilates with the energy of fitness, helping you build strength, improve flexibility, increase mobility and feel your best—whether you're completely new to Pilates or already experienced.

As part of the Energym community, we're passionate about making Pilates accessible, enjoyable and empowering for everyone. Our expert instructors will support and motivate you through every class, helping you progress at your own pace in a friendly and inclusive environment.

​

Whether your goal is to complement your gym training, improve your overall fitness, recover from injury, or simply enjoy a new way to move, Reform by Energym is here to help you become stronger, healthier and more confident.

Reconnect Mind and Body
